pages.text: $(bold)Self-Embodiment of Perfection$(): wager the small against the great, staking curse power and fate itself.$(br2)Drains radius x20 curse power per second. Every 3 seconds the domain rolls the lottery:$(li)$(green)Small prize (70%)$(): +250 curse power and Absorption IV for 10 seconds$(li)$(dark_green)Big prize (29%)$(): +900 curse power and Regeneration for 30 seconds$(li)$(gold)Grand prize (1%)$(): unlimited curse power, HP locked at max, and +100 curse affinity for 33 seconds$(br2)After 10 consecutive misses, the 11th draw is guaranteed to be the grand prize.
